comment_text: I tried these (Openrun Pro 2) on at Target along with Sony WH-1000XM6. I was very disappointed with the sound of the XM6. I have no idea how those things would cost $500 from what I was hearing. I was actually extremely impressed with the Pro2s. Seeing all the videos of people saying the sound quality isn't great is making me second guess myself, but I was going back and forth between different headphones in the store. And these by far sounded the best. Very open and not claustrophobic feeling, good bass, clear detail. It felt very immersive. Like when I put them on I had to take them off to see if the sound was somehow not coming from the headphones. It just felt like the music was in my surroundings. And I was also thinking if outside sound was an issue I could put in earplugs to cut out 30 or so decibels while still being able to hear these clearly! I tried plugging my ears to test it out and it introduced some of that claustrophobic feeling but still sounded much better than XM6.
